title: Bupa Arabia renews partnership to promote health through Saudi football | HealthCare Middle East & Africa - No.1 Health & Pharma Manufacturing Industry Publication
summary: Through its collaboration with Thmanyah, Bupa Arabia aims to make discussions about health and wellbeing more relevant to people’s everyday lives.

contentHtml:
SAUDI ARABIA—Bupa Arabia for Cooperative Insurance has renewed its partnership with Thmanyah, a subsidiary of the Saudi Research and Media Group (SRMG), extending its role as a sponsor of Thmanyah’s coverage of Saudi football competitions.

The renewed collaboration combines sport, media and health to promote more active lifestyles and encourage greater awareness of wellbeing among football fans across the Kingdom.

Connecting health with football

Bupa Arabia said the partnership reflects its commitment to engaging people through the interests and experiences that are important to them.

Football remains one of Saudi Arabia’s most popular sports and gives the insurer an opportunity to reach a broad audience with messages about healthy living.

Through its collaboration with Thmanyah, Bupa Arabia aims to make discussions about health and wellbeing more relevant to people’s everyday lives.

By connecting health messages with football content, the company can engage audiences in a familiar setting while encouraging them to consider the role of physical activity in maintaining a healthier lifestyle.

The partnership also supports Bupa Arabia’s broader positioning as a healthcare partner that goes beyond traditional insurance services.

The company combines healthcare, prevention and wellbeing initiatives as part of its approach to helping people improve their quality of life and make healthier choices.

Expanding Bupa Arabia’s sports initiatives

The renewed agreement forms part of Bupa Arabia’s wider involvement in sports and complements initiatives designed to encourage physical activity and community participation.

These initiatives include the Bupa Padel tournaments and the Bupa Marathon, which provide opportunities for people to participate in sport and adopt more active lifestyles.

Together, the programmes support the company’s efforts to integrate health and physical activity into everyday community life.

Bupa Arabia’s continued partnership with Thmanyah also gives the company an additional platform to engage audiences through Saudi football.

Thmanyah’s coverage provides access to football fans while allowing Bupa Arabia to communicate its focus on prevention, wellbeing and healthier living in a way that aligns with their interests.

Supporting Saudi Vision 2030

The partnership with Thmanyah and SRMG also aligns with Saudi Arabia’s broader efforts to promote healthier and more active communities under Saudi Vision 2030.

By combining its healthcare expertise with the reach of sport and media, Bupa Arabia is seeking to encourage greater participation in physical activity and strengthen awareness of healthy lifestyles.

The company will continue using its sports partnerships and community initiatives to engage people around health and wellbeing while supporting efforts to make active living a more visible part of daily life in Saudi Arabia.
